With Stripe's 46-country limit, those in restricted countries like Nigeria are left scrambling for alternatives. But what are the real options for digital sellers in these countries? How do you sell digital products without falling prey to platform restrictions? The answer lies not in workarounds or temporary [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-honest-side-2|solutions]], but in a bold architectural shift towards infrastructure sovereignty.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer some semblance of payment processing for digital creators in restricted countries. However, these platforms come with their own set of limitations and fees. Gumroad, for instance, charges a 3.5% + 30¢ per sale fee, while Lemon Squeezy imposes a flat fee of $15 per month. PayPal, though widely available, operates in over 200 markets, but its account suspension policies can leave creators in a difficult spot, holding funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a seamless and secure payment processing solution for digital creators, with a flat 0.5% fee and no account requirements or KYC restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle may have international reach, but their acceptance of restricted countries is often tenuous at best. In many cases, these platforms will restrict or entirely block creators from these countries, leaving them to navigate a convoluted web of workarounds and third-party services. NOWPayments, on the other hand, operates with a clear and simple approach, accepting over 300 cryptocurrencies and allowing creators to bypass platform restrictions altogether.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed and fees associated with each option are crucial factors for digital creators. Gumroad's 3.5% + 30¢ per sale fee may seem reasonable at first glance, but when multiplied by the number of sales, it can quickly add up. NOWPayments' flat 0.5% fee, on the other hand, offers a more transparent and cost-effective solution. Additionally, NOWPayments' use of blockchain technology enables fast and secure payment processing, with transactions often settling in under 10 minutes.
You own your infrastructure with NOWPayments, not a platform.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For Nigerian digital creators, the choice of payment processing solution is a critical one. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle may seem like viable options at first glance, but their limitations and fees can quickly become a source of frustration. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers a secure, cost-effective, and transparent solution that bypasses platform restrictions altogether. By choosing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), creators can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership in just 48 hours.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
NO KYC restrictions and no account requirements mean you're in control.

If you're still wondering what platform to use for selling digital products in restricted countries, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and its robust features, including automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. Alternatively, read more about how NOWPayments compares to Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle in our detailed comparison.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
